newsitem.title: USA: Republic to acquire FFO Financial.
newsitem.headline: Republic to acquire FFO Financial.

text.p: FFO Financial Group Inc. said Monday it has a definitive agreement to be acquired by Republic Bancshares Inc., another Florida-based banking company, in a deal valued at about $40.3 million.
Republic will offer 0.29 share of its common stock for each of FFO's 8.43 million shares outstanding.
The exchange ratio will change if Republic's stock price drops, but it will not be more than 0.30 share under any circumstances.
Republic's stock rose 25 cents to $16.50, while FFO edged up 12.5 cents to $4.125 on Nasdaq.
FFO, based in St. Cloud, Fla., said it has the right to call off the deal if the average of Republic's stock price is less than $13.50 during a certain period prior to the closing.
Republic Bank operates 33 offices in Pinellas, Pasco, Sarasota, Manatee and Hernando Counties on Florida's west coast.
